findings.title: No re-check of cache after acquiring write lock
findings.body: When several goroutines miss the cache at once, they all queue on Lock(). Each one then re-reads and parses the manifest, because the code does not check `entryPointAssetsCache` again after acquiring the write lock. This is redundant work on cold start. It is also needless serialization in Dev mode, where every request reloads the manifest while holding an exclusive lock. Fix it by adding a double-checked read under the write lock when not in Dev mode.
